用 AI 玩 lo-fi 图像提示仍然是我最喜欢的事情之一。

Playing with lo-fi image prompts is still one of my favorite things with AI. This one I generated months ago and I still like how it came out.

Image made with @grok ✨ 

𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗺𝗽𝘁: A lo-fi cinematic portrait of a young woman with long messy wavy black hair and wispy bangs, sitting in an airport terminal at night. She has warm brown eyes, full glossy lips, and a direct, slightly sultry gaze at the camera. She wears a white ribbed crop tank top and several layered silver chain necklaces. One knee is raised. Background shows large dark windows with out-of-focus city and runway lights, overhead fluorescent strips, and a tall hanging cluster of warm bokeh lights. Shot on analog film, grainy, soft focus, shallow depth of field, muted cinematic color grade, intimate and moody.
